title: Typical design parameters of AO process

cell_spans.description: Printed group heading 'HRT(hours)' spans the Anaerobic and Oxic sub-headings

markdown:
| F/M as MLVSS | SRT (days) | MLSS (mg/l) | Anaerobic | Oxic | Return activated sludge (% of influent) |

notes: Source: Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection

Transcriber layout note: header is printed on two levels. Upper level reads 'F/M as MLVSS', 'SRT (days)', 'MLSS (mg/l)', 'HRT(hours)' and 'Return activated sludge (% of influent)'; lower level reads 'Anaerobic' and 'Oxic' under HRT(hours).
Printed as 'HRT(hours)' with no space before the parenthesis; retained.
Single printed data row under six column headings.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All six headings and six values read from a 420 dpi crop; '0.2-0.7', '2-25', '2,000-4,000', '0.5-1.5', '1-3', '25-40' verified individually.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell, header and note against 144-dpi region renders (all five rotated T5.29 regions included).
